# langsmith_managed_tool_kit (Resource)

Manages a workspace-scoped LangSmith Managed Tools kit: a named selection of tools from registered servers and built-in integrations, exposed through one MCP endpoint. Requires a user-owned API key with `mcp-servers:create`, `mcp-servers:update`, `mcp-servers:delete`, and `mcp-servers:invoke`. LangSmith checks that each linked server exists but not that each tool name exists on it. Updating `tools` replaces the kit's whole selection.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "langsmith_managed_tool_kit" "agent" {
  name        = "Support agent"
  description = "Tools for the support agent."

  tools = [
    {
      server_id = langsmith_managed_tool_server.api_key.id
      tool_name = "search_tickets"
    },
    {
      server_id    = langsmith_managed_tool_server.api_key.id
      tool_name    = "get_ticket"
      exposed_name = "Get ticket"
    },
  ]
}

output "kit_mcp_path" {
  value = langsmith_managed_tool_kit.agent.mcp_path
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Kit name.
- `tools` (Attributes Set) Selected tools. Set exactly one of `server_id` or `builtin_server_key` per tool. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tools))

### Optional

- `connection_policy` (String) `ALLOW_PARTIAL` (default) lists tools from servers the caller has not connected and asks them to connect on call; `REQUIRE_ALL` blocks tool discovery until every credential is connected.
- `description` (String) Kit description.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace that owns this kit. Defaults to the provider workspace. Use `workspace_id/kit_id` when importing into a workspace other than the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Kit ID.
- `mcp_path` (String) Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint path for this kit.

<a id="nestedatt--tools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tools`

Required:

- `tool_name` (String) Tool name on the source server.

Optional:

- `builtin_server_key` (String) LangSmith built-in integration key to select from.
- `exposed_name` (String) Optional display label.
- `server_id` (String) Registered workspace server to select from.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import langsmith_managed_tool_kit.agent '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000006'
terraform import langsmith_managed_tool_kit.agent '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000006'
```
